outbound.label: Charlotte Amalie → Road Town
outbound.note: Three companies rotate the slots. Buy at the terminal — tickets are non-refundable if you miss one.

ferrySchedule.bufferNote: Bags, taxi to the terminal and buying a ticket. An arrival less than 75 minutes before a sailing doesn't realistically make it.

watertaxi.label: Private water taxi
watertaxi.sharedNote: Priced per boat up to 5–8 passengers, so this only makes sense if couples coordinate. Split eight ways it lands much closer to the ferry than the sticker suggests.

operators.name: The Last Mile
operators.sub: 45 min Red Hook → Nanny Cay, customs cleared aboard
